Each 4×4 input matrix $M$ is expanded into an 8×8 matrix composed of 4 quadrants (each 4×4):
- **Top-Left (TL)**: The original input matrix $M$ unchanged:
  $$\text{TL}[r][c] = M[r][c]$$
- **Top-Right (TR)**: The input matrix with rows taken from columns of $M$ from right to left (reflection across the anti-diagonal):
  $$\text{TR}[r][c] = M[c][3 - r]$$
- **Bottom-Left (BL)**: The input matrix rotated by 180° (both horizontal and vertical reflection):
  $$\text{BL}[r][c] = M[3 - r][3 - c]$$
- **Bottom-Right (BR)**: The input matrix transposed and horizontally flipped (reflection across the main diagonal):
  $$\text{BR}[r][c] = M[3 - c][r]$$
